The therapeutic index is a measure of the safety of a drug, calculated as the ratio of the toxic dose (TD50) to the effective dose (ED50).

**Therapeutic Index (TI) = TD50 / ED50 ≈ 80 mg / 40 mg = 2**



### Answer
```C```
